headline: PINBALL's left flank comes alive
lede: The never-dry sweep picked PINBALL and gave the left side of both cabinets what it never had: a counted left ramp, a second kickback save, and a combo that links them. Tap to start — the wires are live tonight.

notes.text: JET LANE: two rollover wires up the left flank — each wire scores, both in one ball SET for the big payout, and the SET lamp keeps its light until the ball ends.
KICKBACK L: the mirror save behind the left flipper tip catches the past-the-tip miss once per side, per ball — same free-save law the right column shipped with.
Combo law: completing a RAMP L SET buys back your spent left kickback once — the flank feeds the save, the save keeps the flank alive.

The ramp's return rolls the ball down the roped outer channel straight through the spinner and kicker — the spinner finally lives on a ramp line, not just on drain misses. EMBER RIDER mirrors everything at its hotter prices.
